title: WINDOW ELECTRIC CONTROL-CONSOLE SWITCHES & WIRING HARNESS
summary: RPO A31 power windows: the two window switches in the rear console (between the seats), the power-window harness and relay. The switches sit under the rear console held by a retainer (screw and nut, retainer on console studs with production nuts); the harness is taped to the console and to the instrument panel harness and clipped across to each door. The power-window relay mounts under the dash 4.10 in. from the car centerline with a screw and washer that also hold the ground wire.

parts.name_expanded: Not printed on the list (blank line); notes A and B say this callout is tape for the harness

View A: the switch retainer goes over studs on the console [2] and is held with production nuts (PROD NUT, no callout); the studs are part of the console.
